sections.title: Kilo minimum-version compatibility
entries: Accept valid Kilo runtime versions at or above 7.4.20, including 7.5.16, without an exact-version allowlist or upper bound. Continue to reject malformed and below-minimum versions and require capability, trust, projection, and containment checks.

sections.title: Verification, recovery guidance, and release evidence
entries: Add minimum-version regression tests, document recovery through the global installation before refreshing consumer projects, and update generated PR verification guidance.
Record and merge the canonical and generated v1.2.0.9016 release attestation.
